en: A cream-colored Olympic-themed postcard with blue and red printing. On the left is a large blue diamond-shaped graphic resembling a postage stamp, filled with pictograms of various sports surrounding the Olympic rings and the number '88. Under this graphic is Hungarian text. On the upper right is a colorful postage stamp depicting two soccer players in action, labeled 'MAGYAR POSTA' with a value of 4 Ft. The stamp is cancelled with a circular postmark including the Olympic rings, a date, and the word 'BUDAPEST.' The right side has red guide lines for the address.
